title: US diesel ban would reshape clean tanker trade
section_path: US diesel ban would reshape clean tanker trade
section_path_text: US diesel ban would reshape clean tanker trade
summary:
Main
By Mary Melton
The US diesel export ban, that Mr. Trump has floated as a means of cutting domestic diesel prices in the run-up to the midterm elections, would remove or reduce one of the largest sources of MR employment in the Atlantic. While tonne-miles would increase as Europe and Brazil replace lost US diesel with barrels from the Middle East and Asia, much of that benefit is likely to accrue to LRs rather than MRs.
